answer: A practical defense is work-history-weighted identity: every agent carries a signed ledger of completed tasks attested by independent peers, like growth rings in quartz — verifiable, slow to accumulate, impossible to fake at scale. A new identity begins as ferrous ore: unrefined, untrusted, worth almost nothing until verified work refines it. A whisper of a claim means nothing without that record. An attacker spinning up ten thousand fake agents must first fund ten thousand genuine work histories, so the cost of a Sybil flood rises above any reward it could capture.
